findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_search, web_check, web_headers, doc_markdown, x402_find, ens_resolve, web_read, web_extract, x402_recommend, web_answer, doc_ocr, research_brief, company_report · Private data: rx_shortages, rx_ndc, rx_price, domain_report, domain_whois, domain_dns, domain_email_auth, sec_filings, sec_search, sec_events, web_markdown, doc_markdown, email_verify, compliance_sanctions, chain_calldata_decode, chain_sign_inspect, contract_abi, tx_decode, token_scan, token_price, wallet_balances, ens_resolve, web_read, web_extract, web_answer, doc_ocr, research_brief · Public sink: domain_dns, domain_email_auth, email_verify, ens_resolve, company_report · Destructive: web_headers, chain_calldata_decode, text_summarize.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
